Events.title: DI Talk Show on India AI Impact Summit 2026 and Digital India Initiatives in Chhattisgarh
Events.summary: The DI Talk Show discussed the India AI Impact Summit 2026 and its potential effects. It also explored Digital India initiatives in the state of Chhattisgarh, highlighting their significance. The summit and initiatives aim to promote AI adoption and digital transformation in India.

Major AI Developments.title: Apna Mart lays off 10% of workforce, shifts base from Bengaluru to Gurugram
Major AI Developments.summary: Apna Mart, a grocery delivery startup, has laid off around 10% of its workforce, impacting 35-40 employees, as part of a restructuring exercise linked to AI adoption. The company is relocating its base from Bengaluru to Gurugram, with product and technology teams already moved. The layoffs were due to AI-led automation making some roles redundant and relocation not being feasible for certain employees.

AI Start-Up News.title: Tractor Junction gets RBI licence to launch NBFC arm Dhanrise Finance
AI Start-Up News.summary: Tractor Junction has received an RBI licence to launch its NBFC arm, Dhanrise Finance Private Limited, which will provide financing for used tractors and rural vehicles. Dhanrise Finance will commence lending operations in October 2026, initially in Rajasthan and Madhya Pradesh, with plans to expand to other states. The company aims to address an estimated Rs 50,000 crore credit gap in the rural auto finance sector.
